about: Responses from the seeded API (seed 2026). The API tests check that the API still returns exactly these; the web tests use them as their mock server.

/api/races?season=2026.name: Hollin Pike Dash
/api/races?season=2026.blurb: Straight up the nose of Hollin Pike and straight back down. The season opener.

/api/races?season=2026.name: Beckside Round
/api/races?season=2026.blurb: A rolling loop of both becks, with one long drag out of the valley.

/api/races?season=2026.name: Scar Edge Horseshoe
/api/races?season=2026.blurb: Three tops along the scar, then a knee-jarring descent through the bracken.

/api/races?season=2026.name: Thrang Moss Trot
/api/races?season=2026.blurb: Fast and wet. Mostly trods across the moss; bring shoes you do not love.

/api/races?season=2026.name: Raven Crag Race
/api/races?season=2026.blurb: A midsummer evening sprint to the crag top. Over in twenty minutes for the fastest.

/api/races?season=2026.name: Three Tarns Traverse
/api/races?season=2026.blurb: The long one: every tarn, every top, a full kit check and a lot of climbing.

/api/races?season=2026.name: Gill Head Gallop
/api/races?season=2026.blurb: Up the gill on rocky steps, back along the old quarry track.

/api/races?season=2026.name: Long Stile Fell Race
/api/races?season=2026.blurb: The championship finale over Long Stile, usually in the season's first proper rain.
